propositions: Production bugs (3435, 3a33, 4dd2, 4c6c) resulted from store write paths bypassing canonical seams using raw git commands in workflows and maintenance code

A deterministic two-layer CI lint (Python AST + workflow/shell cwd-aware scanning) must flag unmarked raw git mutations targeting the tracker, with a mandatory inline marker `# raw-git-ok: <reason>` for sanctioned seam-internal and sandbox writes

The lint must resolve mutation argv via local intra-function tracking (list literals, local variables, splat expansions) and fail-closed on opaque argv, catching the codebase's own write idioms without external allowlists

Sanctioned write surfaces are the store seam internals (gitutil, event_append, txn, purge_bridge) and reconciler seam (git_adapter, _ref_lock), plus disposable sandbox repos (eval_solver, criterion_preview, gerrit_client, opcert_service)
A report-mode bootstrap scan produces the authoritative inventory of legitimate write sites; every hit is remediated or marked, then the lint enforces in the same PR
